t: This is 85 Fleet Street, a prominent Grade II listed building on Fleet Street, listed here under the address 9 Salisbury Court. It was commissioned by the Reuters news agency. The architect was Sir Edwin Lutyens, known for imaginatively adapting traditional architectural styles to the needs of his era. He designed many country houses, war memorials and public buildings. The writer Christopher Hussey said that in his lifetime Lutyens was widely held to be our greatest architect since Wren.
